trap.label: discurso indireto de ordens
trap.wrong: Ana told me that I bring dessert.
trap.right: Ana told me to bring dessert.
trap.why: Em português “Ana disse que eu levasse” usa que + subjuntivo. Em inglês, ordens e pedidos relatados usam tell/ask + pessoa + (not) to + verbo.

mcq.q: “Don’t be late.” → She asked us ___ late.
“Bring dessert.” → Ana ___ me to bring it.
Which is correct? (discurso indireto de ordens)

fix.wrong: She asked us don't be late.
fix.right: She asked us not to be late.

fix.wrong: Ana told that I bring it.
fix.right: Ana told me to bring it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Bring dessert,” Ana said to me.
rewrite.answer: Ana told me to bring dessert.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Don’t be late,” she said to us.
rewrite.answer: She asked us not to be late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Stay here,” he said to them.
rewrite.answer: He told them to stay here.
